SELECT BOARD_ID, TITLE FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE = #{boardType} AND (REGIST_DT < #{registDt} OR (REGIST_DT = #{registDt} AND BOARD_ID < #{boardId})) ORDER BY REGIST_DT DESC, BOARD_ID DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT BOARD_ID, TITLE FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE = #{boardType} AND (REGIST_DT > #{registDt} OR (REGIST_DT = #{registDt} AND BOARD_ID > #{boardId})) ORDER BY REGIST_DT ASC, BOARD_ID ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT BOARD_ID, BOARD_TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, VIEW_CNT, REGIST_DT, REGISTER FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD ( BOARD_ID, BOARD_TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, VIEW_CNT, REGIST_DT, REGISTER ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{boardType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{atchFileGrpid}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{register} )
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, ATCH_FILE_GRPID = #{atchFileGrpid}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDUSR = #{updusr} WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
